questions.question: How sharp is the main subject?

real_s1.explanation: The unit responds most to a single clear, sharp, well-lit main subject that fills much of the frame and sits roughly centered, in photos with neutral colors and no strong warm tint. It is weaker on cluttered scenes with no single main subject, on dark or blurry subjects, and on warm-toned images.

real_s2.explanation: The unit prefers photos with a single, clear, well-defined main subject: one that is sharp, brightly lit, fills a large part of the frame and sits centrally. It responds weakly to cluttered scenes with no single main subject, dark scenes, and blurry ones. It also prefers natural, untinted color over warm-tinted photos. Facing direction, tilt and cropping matter little.

real_s3.explanation: The unit is most active on photos with one clear, well-lit, sharp main subject that fills much of the frame, such as cameras, dogs, gadgets and spiders, and usually sits near the center. It is least active on cluttered scenes with no single subject, on dark or blurry photos, and on photos with a warm color cast. Its preference for untinted, neutral-color photos over warm-tinted ones rests on large photo groups, and the similar units do not share it.

null_s1.explanation: Within its top classes, the unit is most active when the main subject faces or points to the right, and when the subject sits in the left or middle of the frame rather than the right third. It prefers photos with neutral or cool colour over a warm yellow, orange or red tint. These preferences are particular to this unit: the similar units mostly fall below the 95th percentile on these rows.

null_s2.explanation: Within its top classes (cameras, small dogs, gadgets, spiders/butterflies), this unit is more active when the main subject faces or points right and sits left of or at the center rather than in the right third. It also prefers photos without a warm yellow/orange/red tint, favoring neutral or cool color casts. These orientation, position and tint preferences are distinctive: the similar units are mostly below the 95th percentile on these rows.

null_s3.explanation: Within its preferred classes (cameras, small fluffy dogs, gadgets, spiders, arches), this unit is more active when the main subject faces or points right and sits left of center or in the middle rather than in the right third. It is also more active on photos with neutral or cool color than on warm-tinted (yellow/orange/red) ones. The rightward-facing and no-warm-tint preferences are particular to it; the similar units do not share them.
